title: Resampling disagreement and conditional variance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. For each coordinate $i$, project onto all coordinates except $i$ the function that, at each input, is the $\pi$-probability that resampling coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$. The resulting function equals one half of the conditional variance of $f$ in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
